Name: AHIPCareConsideration

Name: AHIPDemoGenderIdentityValueSet

Description: Used as the answer options for the gender question in the SOGI and Relationship Status Section, capturing a patient's gender identity. Based on the HL7 Gender Identity value set

Name: AHIPDisability

Name: AHIPInterpreterModes

Name: AHIPMilitaryPeriod

Name: AHIPOutreachMode

Name: AHIPPreferredPronouns

Name: AHIPRaceEtnicityCategories

Name: AHIPReadingLanguagePreferences

Name: AHIPRelationshipStatus
